_comment: Orca layout for the desktop helper. Lives at ~/.config/overhaul/orca-layout.json on the machine that runs Orca (or OVERHAUL_LAYOUT). Generate it on the hub host with `overhaul orca-layout` (from config.yaml: public_url, orca.agents_dir, each project's host and tmux session). hub: the hub link Orca opens; origins: every URL the hub page is opened from (the helper answers only those); one Orca project per hub project, an empty git folder under agentsDir.
